title: aws-design.json — Design phase (IaC route) artifact contract
description: The FLOOR contract for the Design phase's infrastructure-route artifact. Encodes required structure only (additional properties are allowed) so a legitimate richer artifact never trips a false GATE_FAIL. The interpreter validates a produced aws-design.json against this schema at the Design completion gate and at the Estimate entry gate; CI validates only that this schema file exists and is well-formed.

phase.description: Must be the literal 'design' (identifies the producing phase).

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the artifact was produced.

services.description: One entry per mapped resource. May be empty ONLY when every discovered resource was deferred to specialist engagement.

service_id.description: Stable identifier for this mapped service within the design.

source_resource_id.description: The GCP resource id this entry maps from.

aws_service.description: The target AWS service, or 'Deferred — specialist engagement' when no automated mapping applies (e.g. BigQuery).

confidence.description: Mapping confidence (numeric score or a qualitative band).

aws_config.description: The concrete AWS configuration chosen for this service (sizing, tier, options).

total_services.description: MUST equal services[].length. The equality itself is a cross-field invariant the interpreter checks via an _assert (a schema cannot express it).
